[SWS_DM_00880] Debounce time freeze request
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04068, RS_Diag_04225
⌈
If the
ara::diag::Monitor::ReportMonitorAction
method of a
ara::
diag::Monitor
instance is called with the parameter
action
set to
kFreezeDe-
bouncing
, for events with
DiagEventDebounceTimeBased
debouncing, the DM
shall freeze the related debounce timer of the corresponding
event
.
⌋
Freezing of the timer is only supported for events with
DiagEventDebounceTime-
Based
debouncing.
